title: fix(plugin-auth)!: Copy Invite Link is no longer offered or answered for a pending invitation past its expiry
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XFRN2q4SMrFcvRtmNhBFXJG)_

Fixes #28384

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：邀请的「复制邀请链接」现在除了看状态是否为 pending，还看 `expires_at`。邀请已过期但状态仍是 pending 时，行菜单和记录页头不再显示这个操作；直接调用也会被拒，返回 409 `RESOURCE_CONFLICT`，文案说明邀请已过期、请重新发送。
- 为什么改：卡 #28384 与分诊 6541933328：过期邀请没有任务把状态改成 expired，管理员仍能复制并发出一个对方打开即被拒的链接。
- 风险与回滚：这是对一个平台操作的收紧（changeset 已标 BREAKING，`Clause-②: no (narrowing)`）。未过期的 pending 邀请照旧拿到链接；「重新发送邀请」不受影响，过期邀请上仍然显示，是补救办法。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/invitation-link-action.ts` 的新过期门（排在 pending 门之后）与 `isBeforeExpiry`；`packages/platform-objects/src/identity/sys-invitation.object.ts` 中 `copy_invitation_link` 的 `visible`；`invitation-delivery-outcome.test.ts` 末尾新增的 describe 块。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/invitation-delivery-outcome.test.ts`，预期 32 条全绿，其中过期 pending 邀请得 409。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

**The rule.** An expired invitation's link is no longer offered or answered. A `sys_invitation` row can still read `pending` after its `expires_at` has passed, because nothing moves it to `expired`.

- **Handler** (`packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/invitation-link-action.ts`). `createCopyInvitationLinkHandler` now reads `expires_at` with the row and adds a sixth gate after the pending gate, in the order the docblock lists: a row whose `expires_at` is not in the future is refused `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT` with "This invitation has expired, so its link no longer lets anyone join. Resend the invitation to give the person a link that works." A missing or unreadable `expires_at` counts as expired, the way the vendor's own check reads it. The value is read whether the driver returns a `Date`, ISO text or epoch milliseconds. Reach is still judged first, so a caller outside the invite reach learns nothing about an expired row.
- **Visibility** (`packages/platform-objects/src/identity/sys-invitation.object.ts`). `copy_invitation_link`'s `visible` adds `has(record.expires_at) && record.expires_at != null && datetime(record.expires_at) > now()`. `has()` opens the operand for the sparse `list_item` face, as `status` is opened, and the `!= null` half is the one an ordering comparison needs (the rule in `materializeDeclaredFields`, `packages/objectql/src/declared-fields.ts`). The grid already puts every `record.FIELD` an action predicate names into the row `$select` (`collectPredicateFieldRefs`), so no list view needed a new column.
- **Resend is unchanged.** Measured before touching it: `resend_invitation` does not share the copy-link check (its `visible` is the lowered feature and reach gates only), and it is the remedy, so it stays offered on an expired row and gets no expiry gate.

## Tests

- `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/invitation-delivery-outcome.test.ts`, new block `#28384 (e)`, on a real `AuthManager` over the installed better-auth: an expired pending row is refused 409 `RESOURCE_CONFLICT` and the message's first sentence is pinned; a row with an unreadable `expires_at` is refused the same way; controls: a pending row before expiry still answers its link for a `Date`, ISO text and epoch-milliseconds value; a plain member on an expired row still gets 403 (reach before expiry); Resend still answers 200 for the invitee and its answer has a link to copy.
- `packages/platform-objects/src/identity/invitation-delivery-copy.test.ts`: the evaluated `visible` is false on a pending row past `expires_at`, and on a pending row projected without, or holding no, `expires_at`; Resend's evaluated `visible` stays true on that expired row. The existing "offered on a pending row" fixtures now carry a future `expires_at`.

## Acceptance notes

- **`Clause-②` measured as `no (narrowing)`.** The claim expected `yes (narrowing)`. Measured: the diff narrows one surface (the handler refuses a row it answered, and `visible` follows) and widens none, so the value is `no`, with the narrowing arm.
- **`Metadata-protocol: none`.** No key of any schema moves and no authorable value is refused: the `visible` value of one platform action changes, not its shape.
- **Noted, not filed (seat to judge):** measured on the vendor route in this PR's harness, a resend of an expired pending invitation does not renew that row. better-auth 1.7.12 finds pending invitations with an expiry filter, so it issues a new invitation (a new id) and leaves the expired row reading `pending`. Resend's confirmation text ("Its expiry date starts over") is therefore not what happens on an expired row, and the Pending list then shows both rows for the same person. Out of this card's scope.
